title: Short Academic Biography
text:
Academic Positions

Apr. 2026 – Sep. 2026. Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Mathematics “Giuseppe Peano”, Università degli Studi di Torino, Italy. Research on the N-body problem.
Apr. 2023 – Mar. 2026. RTD-a Researcher (MAT/05), Department of Mathematics “Giuseppe Peano”, Università degli Studi di Torino, Italy.
Oct. 2022 – Mar. 2023. Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Mathematics, Università di Pisa, Italy. Research on dispersive and Hamiltonian equations.
Oct. 2021 – Sep. 2022. Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Mathematics and Computer Science “Ulisse Dini”, Università degli Studi di Firenze, Italy. Research on PDEs for fluid dynamics.
Jan. 2020 – Sep. 2021. Postdoctoral Researcher, Department of Sciences and Methods for Engineering, Università degli Studi di Modena e Reggio Emilia, Italy. Research on mathematical models for collective movements, crowd dynamics, and vehicular traffic.
Apr. – Dec. 2019. Postdoctoral Researcher, Severo Ochoa Excellence Programme, ICMAT–CSIC, Madrid, Spain.



Education

Ph.D. in Mathematics, Università degli Studi di Firenze, Italy, 2019.
Thesis: Asymptotic analysis of solutions related to the game-theoretic (p)-Laplacian.
Advisor: Rolando Magnanini.

title: Research Interests
text: My research interests lie broadly in Mathematical Analysis, with particular emphasis on partial differential equations, dynamical systems, and problems arising in mathematical physics.

title: Research Interests
section: Celestial Mechanics and the N-body Problem
text:
Celestial Mechanics and the N-body Problem
I am interested in analytical and variational aspects of the N-body problem, including Hamilton–Jacobi equations, regularity properties, expansive solutions, and the behavior of solutions at infinity.

title: Research Interests
text:
Nonlinear Partial Differential Equations
My research includes the qualitative analysis of nonlinear PDEs, with particular interest in:

Hamilton–Jacobi equations
Parabolic equations
Diffusion–convection–reaction equations
Degenerate and sign-changing diffusion
Traveling waves and wavefronts

title: Research Interests
text:
Asymptotic Analysis
I study asymptotic properties of solutions to elliptic and parabolic equations, including short-time behavior and problems related to the game-theoretic (p)-Laplacian and Pucci operators.

title: Research Interests
text:
Fluid Dynamics and Mathematical Models
I have also worked on PDE models arising in fluid dynamics and mathematical physics, including tropical climate models and the dynamics of complex bodies.
